neighbours.label: The last digit of a journal volume number that directly follows the journal's name in a bibliographic citation
fire: Brown, T. and Ellis, R. Pollination in alpine meadows. American Journal of Botany 92: 1021-1031.
Okafor N. Sleep and memory in adolescents. Journal of Neuroscience 34:5412-5420.
Petersen, L. Glacier retreat in Norway. Journal of Glaciology 57, 2011.
Chen Y, Wu H. A new class of superconductors. Science 317: 1196-1199.
Morales, P. (2003). Bird song dialects. Animal Behaviour 65: 899-907.
Hughes, G. Rainfall trends in the Sahel. Climatic Change 48, 2001.
Ito K, Sato M. Quantum dots in silicon. Applied Physics Letters 83: 2441-2443.
Novak, D. Wolves and elk in Yellowstone. Ecology 84: 1205-1214.
quiet: Brown and Ellis counted 92 flowers in the alpine meadow and tagged 31 of them.
Okafor tested 34 adolescents, and 12 of them slept under six hours.
The glacier in Norway retreated 57 metres between 2009 and 2011.
The new superconductor works at 317 kelvin, the authors reported in March.
Morales recorded 65 birds in 2003 and found 9 song dialects.
Rainfall in the Sahel fell 48 percent below the 2001 average.
The silicon wafer held 83 quantum dots spaced 24 nanometres apart.
Rangers counted 84 wolves and 1205 elk in Yellowstone that winter.

notes: Card: digits right after 'Canad. J. Bot.', 'Science', 'Nature', 'Biological Conservation'. Probes: 'Nature 171' 0.99, 'Physical Review B 79' 0.76, 'Journal of Ecology 86' 0.67; street numbers, scores, page numbers 0.01.
